not_done.item: [1] export caption file name broken across the bidi boundary
not_done.why: NOT REPRODUCIBLE, and the proposed fix measured as a regression - so it was implemented, measured and reverted. The anomaly cites results/evidence/CEO-m2-exec-overview-export-caption-block.png as two lines with .xlsx at the left of line 2; in that exact PNG, and in the full page CEO-m2-exec-overview.png at 1280px, the caption is ONE line and .xlsx sits at its far left = the logical END of the name read right-to-left, which is correct for a Hebrew reader. Wrapping the name in <bdi dir=ltr> moved .xlsx to immediately after the word יירד, before the name. Side-by-side evidence: scratchpad/results-fix/evidence/bar2-before.png vs bar2-after.png (and caption-zoom-before.png vs caption-zoom.png). ExportBar is unchanged apart from a why-first comment; a new ExportBar.test.jsx now LOCKS the measured-correct rendering (exact caption text, no isolate characters, no bdi/dir node) so the non-fix cannot slip in later without a fresh measurement.

The moment it lands the shell fixes m22 with no further code change; v_from is computed at line 3177 of the same file.

blind_spot: src/modules/11_reports/ReportsPage.jsx - readScope only ever fires from a payload that LOADED (ReportSurface calls onWindow after a successful callReport). So every filter guarantee added here is silent in the two states where no payload exists: loading and error. Concrete, checkable scenario: open /reports?tab=hostesses&report=hostess-overview&customer=414 with the RPC aborted (the evidence runner's --extras error does exactly this) and the customer selector is enabled with 'בטא הפקות' selected, on a surface whose RPC declares customer_filter_ignored: true. One runner call settles it true-or-false; the fix, if Ishay wants it, is a static per-surface declaration in reportsCatalog.js instead of a per-payload flag.
